items.title: Menu items
items.description: Raw items: [{ name, description?, ingredients?, price?, category? }]. Provide price as text, such as "$12.50" or "12.50".

description.title: Description
description.description: Short description shown on the menu.

price.title: Price
price.description: Menu price as text, such as "$12.50" or "12.50".

category.title: Category
category.description: Menu category, such as Mains or Drinks.

batchSize.title: LLM batch size
batchSize.description: Items per initial tagging call. Defaults to 8; failed batches are retried as smaller groups.
